fields.label: Pooja
fields.description: The name of the pooja, for example Panchopchar. The digital temple performs it step by step, in the order of the steps below.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: When there is more than one pooja, the one with the lowest number is offered first.

fields.label: About this pooja
fields.description: A line of words about the pooja, shown under its name.

fields.label: Sound when the doors open
fields.description: A recording of a conch, played when the person opens the temple doors. Blank: the temple makes a conch sound of its own.

fields.label: Sound of the bell
fields.description: A recording of a bell, played with each offering and when the person rings the bell. Blank: the temple makes a bell sound of its own.

fields.label: Sound when the pooja is complete
fields.description: Played when the last offering is made. Blank: a conch and a long bell of its own.

fields.label: Aarti
fields.description: The aarti, played again and again while the person performs the aarti. Blank: bells and a beat of its own.
